chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abu Wallad al-Hannat, who said:
I heard Abu Abdullah عليه السلام say: "Whoever intentionally kills himself will be in the Fire of Hell, abiding therein forever."
ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about intentionally killing oneself?
ai.summary: This hadith strongly condemns intentional self-killing and warns of severe punishment in the Fire of Hell. It underscores the sanctity of life and presents suicide as a grave sin with consequences in the afterlife.
